dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, AWS COG, 2021 release

source.coverage_purpose: 盘锦校园及周边缓冲区矩形，覆盖共同WGS84运行范围及滤波边界，不等同校界。

acquisition: TanDEM-X 2011–2015；局部补洞可能使用更早数据，未核实逐像元采集日期。
attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
liability_notice: The organisations in charge of the Copernicus programme by law or by delegation do not incur any liability for any use of the Copernicus WorldDEM-30
campus_accuracy: 未通过校内实测控制点核验；采样间距不等于测量精度。
processing: 原始像素窗口裁剪及 JSON 无损转换；无重采样、平滑、去建筑、去树冠或垂直基准转换。
model_alignment: 源网格为WGS84，须由共享校区原点转换；禁止叠加旧官网经验平移。
use: 离线原始DSM资料；运行过滤、地坪估计及精度边界见references/shared/terrain/basis.md。
